# Reference repositories

These repositories are read-only implementation references, excluded from this project's Git history.
The simulation imports no code from them. See [third_party_notes](../docs/third_party_notes.md)
for the precise concepts inspected and adapted.

| Directory | Upstream |
| --- | --- |
| TwinMarket | https://github.com/FreedomIntelligence/TwinMarket |
| Mean-Field-LLM | https://github.com/Miracle1207/Mean-Field-LLM |
| ACL24-EconAgent | https://github.com/tsinghua-fib-lab/ACL24-EconAgent |
| LAMP | https://github.com/hey0223/LAMP |
| StockAgent | https://github.com/MingyuJ666/Stockagent |

Run `git clone --depth 1 URL third_party/NAME` from the project root if a reference is missing.
